name: CreateDocParserJob

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the document parsing task. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 文档解析任务所属的地域ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URL of the document to be parsed.

This parameter is automatically populated when you call this operation by using an SDK
parameters.help_zh:
待解析文档的OSS地址。

通过SDK调用时该参数为自动填充
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.help_en:
The name of the document to be parsed.

The name must include the file name extension. Currently, only .pdf is supported
parameters.help_zh:
待解析文档的名称。

包含扩展名，当前仅支持.pdf
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en:
The output format of the parsing result after the task is complete. Valid values:

zip: a ZIP compressed file.
content: plain text
parameters.help_zh:
解析任务完成后输出结果的格式，取值为：

zip：zip压缩包。
content：纯文本
parameters.name: result_type
